title: Roundtown Players Presents Sally Cotter and the Censored Stone - NewsBreak
text:
By Dave Horning ,
14 hours ago
(CIRCLEVILLE) — Roundtown Players Theatre brings the family-friendly parody Sally Cotter and the Censored Stone to the stage this weekend and next. Written by Dean O’Carroll, this fast-paced comedy play reimagines the world of a certain boy wizard through the eyes of a heroine who dreams her way into the halls of Frogbull Academy of Sorcery.
When Sally falls asleep while reading her favorite fantasy books, she awakens in a world filled with quirky professors, magical creatures, and the looming threat of the villainous Lord Murderdeath. Alongside her new friends Dave and Harmonica, Sally must navigate both danger and hilarity while contending with the mysterious Censor who keeps rewriting the story.
The lead role of Sally Cotter is being performed by Kyra Dunkle, a 6th grader at Logan Elm Middle School acting in her 6th Roundtown Player production.
“I’m also really happy because the play’s coming along great,” said Kyra. “And it was pretty fun learning the lines and getting to act them out on stage.” Kyra also said that she really enjoys the final scene … but giving more detail here would ruin it for those planning to attend!
Also acting in the play is Bekah Clark in the role of Harmonica, a friend of Sally Cotter who helps defeat the schemes of the evil Lord Murderdeath.
Laura Mears, the play’s director, said, “It’s been a wonderful experience.
I’m a huge Harry Potter fan, so when I first read this play, I thought how exciting it would be to direct it. And the set and the kids and the adults have done a wonderful job.”
The set looks amazing, and it was interesting to learn that it was designed by AI. Also behind the scenes, the tech crew has been dealing with some good and bad news. The good news is that Roundtown Players have new soundboard used for the first time at the last show. The bad news is that the system does not always do what it is told to do. When asked if being backstage was also a glamorous part of theatre life, the answer was, “No!.”
Performance Dates:
Friday, September 26 at 7:30 PM (Opening Night)
Saturday, September 27 at 7:30 PM
Sunday, September 28 at 2:30 PM
Friday, October 3 at 7:30 PM
Saturday, October 4 at 7:30 PM
Sunday, October 5 at 2:30 PM
Location:
Roundtown Players Theatre
165 1/2 E. Main Street
Circleville, Ohio 43113
Tickets are available now and can be purchased online at www.roundtownplayers.org or at the door on show nights.
